20

Eniola

Scroll down. I have a lot to say. ❤️

Happy 20th Birthday, my love. ❤️❤️

I remember the very first day I met you. 🥹❤️

So young, so small and so innocent you looked. Hmm… let me say innocent me too. 😁😂 That was one of those days I was just coming back from my usual Ado trip.

You came to charge your phone at our hostel, and Yusuf was like, “This is one of our coursemates.”

And gentle me, being the gentleman that I am, was like, “Wowww! Hi, my name is Victor. What’s your name, please?”

And you, reluctantly, replied, “Eniola.”

Oh, nice meeting you, Eniola. 😂❤️

Little did I know that this same reluctant Eniola would eventually become someone I wouldn’t go a day without talking to.

Like play, like play, look at how far we’ve come. I honestly don’t know how it all happened because you were so principled, difficult to access, strong-headed and, let’s not forget, had your own little wickedness. 😂❤️

But honestly, it’s crazy how time flies.

That little, innocent girl is 20 today. Waoh! 🥹🎂

I never knew I could feel this close, comfortable and safe with someone until I got to experience you. Your personality, your beauty, your words, your strength, your kindness and even those little things you do without realising how much they mean to me.

Sometimes, I just sit and think about how beautiful it is that our paths crossed. I genuinely bless the day you came to charge your phone at our hostel. If only you knew how much that one little moment would eventually mean to me. 🥲❤️

You’ve been my help, my support system, my best friend, my baby and, of course, the only person who has the special privilege of pulling my ears whenever she feels like it. 😂

You’ve come through for me in so many ways. At different points when I needed help, you showed up. You’ve supported me with school activities, work, family matters and even those moments when I didn’t know how to figure things out myself.

You were also the person who taught me how to celebrate myself, appreciate my little wins and understand that even the smallest achievements deserve to be celebrated.

And for all of these things, I don’t think I say thank you enough.

I know we haven’t had the smoothest journey. We’ve had our rough days, moments of misunderstanding, quarrels, arguments, fights and times when we probably got on each other’s nerves. 😂

But through it all, you’ve remained someone I hold very dearly. You’ve shown up, you’ve listened, you’ve encouraged me and you’ve stood by me in ways I will never take for granted.

It’s been four years since we met, and somehow, it still feels like yesterday. Four years of memories, laughter, lessons, growth, disagreements, forgiveness and beautiful moments.

Eniola, you’re an amazing woman. A strong woman. I’ve watched you face different battles, deal with difficult situations and carry so much on your shoulders, yet you keep pushing. Sometimes, I wish you could see yourself through my eyes because perhaps then you’d understand just how much strength, courage and beauty you carry.

If I begin to count everything about you, I honestly don’t know where I’ll stop.

There was even a point when I started questioning our friendship, not because you weren’t enough, but because I had grown so attached to having you in my life that I couldn’t imagine what things would look like without you. That’s how much of a special place you’ve occupied in my heart.

I honestly don’t have enough words to describe how wonderful you are, Eniola. You’re one of the most beautiful blessings life has given me, and I’m grateful that I get to witness another chapter of your life.

But today isn’t about me or how much I love having you around. Today is about YOU. The beautiful woman you’re becoming, the battles you’ve fought, the lessons you’ve learnt and the many beautiful things still waiting for you.

Happy 20th Birthday, my woman! 🥹❤️🎂

You’re a woman of virtue, grace, strength and courage. A woman with so much potential and a beautiful future ahead of her.

Happy 20th, Enny ❤️
